limitations: Simulation includes serial-joint armature and total-torque clipping, not a validated model of the real parallel motor loop.

MotorDebug has 24 motor values plus a DataMonitor timestamp, verified against installed binary.
The bench supervisor can handle a worker hang on the onboard host; it cannot guarantee recovery from OS, DDS or motor-bus failure.
